programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Call him a city slicker. Call him a tenderfoot. But don't call him a member of the family yet. Rising L.A. lawyer James White is going home for the holidays with his fiancée, Sadie Ryder, to finally meet her family in rural Pine Gap. After blundering through a bad first impression, James attempts to win over Sadie's lawyer-loathing father Karl by pretending to be a horse-riding, hay-baling, game-hunting, seasoned square dancer. But a pair of worn jeans and a ten-gallon hat don't make a cowboy, and it's going to take more than mere posturing to charm Mr. Ryder...in fact, it just may take a miracle.

programme.title: For Love Alone: The Ivana Trump Story
programme.desc: The triumphs and tragedies of Katrinka Kovár, a young Czechoslovakian ski prodigy who discovers high-society splendor in the arms of a wealthy American businessman. When lust turns to lies, Katrinka--long haunted by a burning secret from her past--sets out to find the love she left behind.

programme.title: Ordinary Miracles
programme.desc: Drama with Jaclyn Smith. A kindhearted judge agrees to take in a juvenile delinquent, hoping to help the youngster rehabilitate and face her troubled past.

programme.title: The King and Queen of Moonlight Bay
programme.desc: 17-year-old Alison embarks on a mission: to find the father who abandoned her family when she was five years old, try to understand the past, and reestablish a relationship with the stranger she has never forgotten.

programme.title: The Day of the Triffids
programme.desc: Sci-fi mini-series based on the classic novel by John Wyndham. Dougray Scott stars as Bill Masen, an expert on a species of plant that killed his mother in the 1970s. The species, known as triffids, can be used as an alternative fuel and help end global warming. Unfortunately, triffids are extremely dangerous. They are mobile, carnivorous, intelligent, and wreak havoc wherever they go. Starring Joely Richardson, Brian Cox, Vanessa Redgrave and Eddie Izzard.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Historical drama series based on the escapades of Marco Polo: an infamous merchant-turned-explorer who travelled through Asia in the 13th century. Finding himself in the upper echelons of the Mongol Empire, the Venice-born Marco Polo embarks on a series of adventures in a world filled with war, revenge, tough decisions, love, loyalty, and betrayal. Starring Lorenzo Richelmy as Marco Polo.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: Edmund acts as a witness to the wedding between the injured Prettiman and Miss Granham, with flowers grown by the captain in his window boxes. Despite initial animosity towards him Edmund starts to show some admiration for the older man's liberal ideas. With the mast broken the ship is drifting perilously close to an ice-field but Benet saves the situation by pouring molten lead into the mast's base, which steadies it and the ship reaches Sydney safely. Due to Edmund's influence Summers is given his own ship but dies when it catches fire though for Edmund there is a happy ending as he is reconciled with Marion, who has also arrived in Sydney.

programme.title: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
programme.desc: In The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon, Daryl (Noman Reedus) washes ashore in France and struggles to piece together how he got there and why. The series tracks his journey across a broken but resilient France as he hopes to find a way back home. As he makes the journey, though, the connections he forms along the way complicate his ultimate plan.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: Otto is waiting for a very important package, but the conveyor belt at the ABDS breaks down.

programme.title: Niagara Motel
programme.desc: A group of struggling individuals cross paths at a low-rent motel in Niagara Falls: a knockout waitress being recruited to star in low budget porn videos, a young couple with a criminal past struggling to recover their child from social services, a middle class husband and wife in a marriage that is disintegrating, a woeful drunken motel manager, a prostitute working to support two small children...

programme.title: Selling Innocence
programme.desc: Mia Sampson (Sarah Lind), an unpopular girl, is approached at the mall one day to become a model. Even though she thinks modeling is shallow, she thinks it will be a better way to earn money than working for a sushi restaurant and goes to the agency. She poses for photographs which are to be displayed on an Internet website for "members only," supposedly so she can be scouted for other modeling jobs. As Mia's membership begins to go up, she begins feeling uncomfortable and also receives disturbing messages from a subscriber known as Gabriel. However, she continues to take shots and even participates in live video chats with the gentlemen of the site. Too late, Mia realizes that she is working for a pornography site and goes to a group called webwatch to uncover the operation. However, since the agency isn't doing anything illegal, the police can't do anything.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: 1800:- Young Edmund Talbot is sailing to Australia to take up a government post, on a decrepit old ship skippered by Captain Anderson, who is hostile to Edmund until he realizes that he has important relatives. Far more admirable to Edmund are Lieutenants Summer, who has worked his way up through the ranks, and the dashing Deverel. His fellow passengers number demure governess Miss Granham, the republican Mr Prettiman and artist Mr Brocklebank, travelling with his wife and daughter Zenobia - who initiates Edmund into sex - though ultimately he realizes that they are not related, merely a carnal ménage a trois. Also on board is the gauche young vicar Colley, who inadvertently breaches protocol by going onto the bridge uninvited. Ashamed he gets drunk and has gay sex with crew members before locking himself in his cabin, where, despite Edmund's efforts to bring about reconciliation, he wastes away and dies.

His world needs him; the evil ruler of Earthsea, King Tygath, wants to govern the land with an iron fist, but Ged must learn to harness his powers before he can save his people. Two-part fantasy adventure series.

programme.desc: Ex-lawman Matt Austin (Luke Perry) accidentally kills an innocent man (Alex Paez) while hunting an outlaw who killed his family. He pledges to the dying man that he will take his body to his sister Amaya (Jaclyn DeSantis). Austin wrestles with the idea of telling her he caused the death, but is faced with bigger battles once at the farm. There he gets involved with land baron Horn (C. Thomas Howell), who is trying to take Amaya's land. Their lives are more intertwined than he thought, when he takes on Horn and discovers that Horn has hired the man he was looking for all along.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth
programme.desc: The ship is becalmed and another vessel is sighted, which turns out to be British - the Alcyone, whose commander announces that the war with France is over. The two vessels anchor alongside and a ball is held for the passengers. Here Edmund meets the sweet Marion Chumley, though he has a rival for affections in Deverel. However, when the two ships part Deverel is exchanged for the Alcyone's officer, the urbane Benet and Edmund confides in Summers his regret at having to say goodbye to Marion. A storm blows up, during which the unfortunate steward Wheeler, considered a Jonah, is thrown overboard and Prettiman severely injured, being nursed rather unexpectedly by Miss Grnham. A mast is also broken and Benet and Summers disagree over the best way to mend it.

programme.title: Mystery Woman
programme.desc: Amicably divorced from art gallery keeper Elliot McCallister, Samantha Kinsey (who always dreamed of being a detective like her prosecutor's office friend, Cassie,) inherits her uncle's mystery-specialized bookshop. It comes with a mysterious clerk, presumed retired spy Ian Philby. Her former literature professor and true crime author Jack Stenning's adopted daughter with psychic abilities, Tracy, bemoans her father's dismissal of her fear of his writing a book about her nightmarish vision of a ten-year-old murder, which reveals a witness survived. At a party in his home to present the new book, Jack is murdered by a surprise guest who brought a noose to stage a suicide and took evidence from the scene. Jack's estranged son Tom and his boss Lt. Robert Hawke investigate but rule suicide. Although his beneficiary, and claiming she loved Jack despite serial adultery, widow Mary asks the bookstore's would-be-sleuths to prove it a murder and solve it. Shortly after, Sam is the target of a break-in and sabotage.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 1: Mystery Weekend
programme.desc: When the book shop hosts a mystery weekend, recluse hit author Clare Beckman announces her retirement, DA Cassie is hit by what may well be a failed attempt. Charming new lawyer Scott Tyler dates both friends. The weapon was registered by oldest attending local Dorothy, who rather risks arrest by the chief then accepting help or disclosing the truth, including about her ex Derek. Later, Clare mysteriously dumps fiancee Grant and dies from bee poison, which only works due to her allergy which few people knew about.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 2: Snapshot
programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey's latest case has her trying to figure out who killed her best friend Barbara after she was left out of her family's will and every one of the family members become suspects.

The next day, she disappears along with Kai.

programme.title: Mary Bryant
programme.desc: Cornwall, 1786, hungry Mary Broad is sentenced to death for stealing a lady's picnic but 'mercifully' allowed to join for life first governor Phillip's founding shipload to start a penal colony at Botany Bay in New South Wales. On board, she fails to be recruited as 'comfort maid' by gentleman marine infantry Lieutenant Ralph Clarke, but gets the job to save her after near drowning, then loses it again by arrogance and becomes pregnant by male convict William 'Will' Bryant. Pioneer life is a relative relief, especially for able fisherman Will's privileged crew. Harvests are disastrous and Mary becomes Ralph's lover, but only to steal his key for Will's elaborate escape party preparations.

programme.title: Mary Bryant

programme.desc: Murder is something to sing about when Mystery Woman Samantha Kinsey-an expert in pulp fiction, and increasingly proficient when it comes to real-life crime-untangles a record-breaking murder. Mystery Woman bookshop owner, Samantha Kinsey, has offered to host a charity concert for a once-famous folk-rock trio out to recapture their old fame flame. But sweet success hits the ultimate sour note when the band's promoter is found murdered in his hotel room. Sam and her partner in crime, Philby, investigate, digging up deadly secrets of private indiscretions, professional greed, and personal vengeance that put a twisted spin on fame and fortune-and bring a whole new meaning to a Top Ten hit.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 4: Vision Of A Murder
programme.desc: Sam lands a job photographing a new spa in Southern California for their brochure and brings her best friend Cassie along to enjoy some pampering. When one of the guests staying at the upscale retreat turns up dead, Sam is once again on the trail of a murderer. As the investigation progresses, Sam uncovers a scam that the spa Dr was testing unapproved drugs on the patrons.. filler implants, etc. without the patients' informed consent.

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Drama with James Earl Jones. A widower opens a reading room, where people can learn to read. But despite his goodwill, problems in the neighbourhood threaten his establishment.

programme.title: The Five People You Meet In Heaven
programme.desc: Social. American social drama, produced in 2004. An accident sends Eddie in Heaven! While there, he meets five people who explain to him what the key moments in his life were, through which the real meaning of his life is recorded.

programme.title: The Five People You Meet In Heaven
programme.desc: Social. American social drama, produced in 2004. An accident sends Eddie in Heaven! While there, he meets five people who explain to him what the key moments in his life were, through which the real meaning of his life is recorded.

programme.title: Dinotopia: The Series
programme.desc: Frank Scott, a wealthy American, crashes his plane into the Caribbean. His two teenaged sons, Karl and David, survive, only to find themselves castaways on Dinotopia. Karl and David are constantly at odds, even as they struggle to adjust to life in their strange new world where talking dinosaurs live side by side in an uneasy alliance with humans. Based upon the book series and the TV miniseries.

programme.title: Word of Honor
programme.desc: A corporate exec and family man is accused of participating in a war crime 30 years earlier during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Stranger with My Face
programme.desc: Mystery with Catherine Hicks. A teenager uncovers a series of shocking revelations when she learns she has an identical twin who has been kept secret from her.

programme.title: Niagara Motel
programme.desc: A group of struggling individuals cross paths at a low-rent motel in Niagara Falls: a knockout waitress being recruited to star in low budget porn videos, a young couple with a criminal past struggling to recover their child from social services, a middle class husband and wife in a marriage that is disintegrating, a woeful drunken motel manager, a prostitute working to support two small children...

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Cat Wars: Lion vs Cheetah
programme.desc: Caught on tape in Africa's wild Serengeti is a stunning act of violence between two top predators. Three cheetahs are brutally attacked by two male lions - the first time an attack like this has ever been filmed. Now, filmmaker Leo Kuenkel, who witnessed the attack, is trying to make sense of it. Was this a once-in-a-lifetime "perfect storm" event? Or do these iconic African cats have a deep-set, sinister reason to fight to the death?

programme.title: Night Stalkers
programme.desc: Unique night vision and thermal cameras penetrate the darkness to reveal Africa's notorious hyenas hunting in their element. Thousands of wildebeest and zebra migrate through Kenya's Masai Mara National Reserve every year and the hyenas team up to hunt them cooperatively. Specially developed cameras reveal a rare, intelligent and playful side to the fascinating animals.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Built to Survive

Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals survive by using camouflage, mimicry, and stealth tactics. From tigers who hunt in plain sight using their orange fur as camouflage, and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony, to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: Explore the many ways wild cats go in for the kill. Cats rarely seen in action, such as the marbled cat, the fishing cat and the sand cat, will all be featured in Cat Attack-tics. Classic Nat Geo footage is mixed with high-tech graphics, freeze frames and photo finishes to magnify the killer weaponry.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: The battle between predator and prey is not always about power and strength. Knowing what lurks in the dark can mean the difference between life and death. Extraordinary powers that penetrate darkness give some creatures the edge, and the chance to live another day.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Killer Whale Chronicles
programme.desc: Orcas are the rulers of the seas. These majestic marine mammals have captured the hearts of people with their intelligence and complex family structures. However, since killer whales started attacking boats near Gibraltar, many are asking: Are they threatening us or just playing? The central revelation is that orcas, with specialized "cultures," perfectly exploit the richness of the seas. Surprisingly, there are different orca cultures around the globe. This episode also showcases impressive images of how the curious whales create genuine "fashions," and meet for mating. Their family groups are led by experienced matriarchs who maintain lifelong bonds with their offspring, particularly their sons. Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor lends her voice to the documentary, giving the orcas' stories a special depth.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: The battle between predator and prey is not always about power and strength. Knowing what lurks in the dark can mean the difference between life and death. Extraordinary powers that penetrate darkness give some creatures the edge, and the chance to live another day.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: In nature, the prevailing rule is "eat or be eaten." Avoiding predators and competition for space, food, and mates is a priority for every animal. But before you can attack, you need to be able to defend yourself. After eons of evolution, animals have developed powerful and surprising defensive techniques that help them avoid, overcome, or escape challengers.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals wage a covert war for survival, deploying their hidden weapons with deadly precision. These adaptations, forged by eons of evolution, give animals the edge they need to outwit predators, rivals, and the elements. From the bombardier beetle's boiling spray to the mantis shrimp's explosive club and the draco lizard's hidden wings, meet nature's awesome secret weapons.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Sixth Sense. To win the game of life, it can take more than brute force. Animals with a super-powered sixth sense can get the edge on fast-moving prey, beat the elements, and find food in unlikely places.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Animals survive by using camouflage, mimicry, and stealth tactics. From tigers who hunt in plain sight using their orange fur as camouflage, and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony, to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Hunters of the Reef
programme.desc: Tropical coral reefs are the picture of colorful, light-dappled tranquility - but that's a scuba diver's perspective. To the scaly and gilled inhabitants, it's a fish-eat-fish environment ruled by pods of dolphins who prowl the area at mealtimes while everyone else runs for cover. Incredible weapons, camouflage, venomous defenses and exceptional strategies have evolved among the smaller hunters in constant competition. Lionfish hunt in packs, injecting any objectors with venom from their frilly spikes. The mantis shrimp has polarized vision and the fastest jab on the planet. Cuttlefish morph their skin to match the sand, then attack with tentacle harpoons. The hunt is on in the shifting tides!

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: Dragons Uncovered
programme.desc: The Komodo Dragon has captured our imaginations for over a century, yet so much about this incredible lizard remains a mystery. A creature with survival skills and physical characteristics seen in apex predators across the animal kingdom, and the ability to take down predators ten times its size. The secrets of the Komodo Dragon are revealed.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe is a continent of diversity, and its coasts are no exception. From the frozen Arctic Ocean, where polar bears and reindeer battle for survival, to the warm beaches of the Mediterranean, home to pink flamingos and killer corals, Europe's coastline attracts a staggering array of wildlife. It's also the setting for some of the world's most jaw-dropping natural spectacles, including orcas and humpback whales hunting side by side, and wild horses running free on the beaches of the Camargue.

programme.title: Cat Attack-Tics
programme.desc: Explore the many ways wild cats go in for the kill. Cats rarely seen in action, such as the marbled cat, the fishing cat and the sand cat, will all be featured in Cat Attack-tics. Classic Nat Geo footage is mixed with high-tech graphics, freeze frames and photo finishes to magnify the killer weaponry.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: Each year, the waters of the Okavango River arrive at the Kalahari in the dead of winter — the driest time of year — transforming the sand into Eden. Discover how this extraordinary event sustains one of Earth's greatest wildlife spectacles. As water spreads across the delta, elephant families march across the desert, lions stake their claims, hidden ecosystems awaken, and crocodiles, fish, birds and insects respond in perfect synchrony to the river's advance. But this miracle is fleeting, and survival demands perfect timing. From underwater worlds concealed beneath papyrus roots to lion ambushes on flooded plains, follow the rhythm of a river that awakens, feeds and withdraws, leaving both abundance and loss in its wake. This is the story of a place where everything depends on water … and where Eden never lasts.

programme.title: Lions: The Hunt For Survival
programme.desc: Lions - the most feared, most iconic predator in Africa but a lion is not just a lion. Each is very different to the other. Different parts of Africa demand specific things from lions to survive. The secret is to be highly adaptable. At the end of the day, the livelihood of the pride rests on the female's shoulders. She's the one who must excel. Follow three lionesses from different parts of the continent to see how they respond to win?

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: On this special episode, the clinic is buzzing with kids and their beloved pets! From confident young caretakers to nervous first-time visitors, it's a heartwarming look at the special bond kids share with their animals. Dr. Pol and his team treat a kitten with a painful eye injury, a cat recovering from a dog attack, a fair goat with a split ear, and even a bearded dragon! Along the way, kids roll up their sleeves as they help with exams, ask thoughtful questions, and celebrate their county fair victories. With encouragement from Dr. Pol, kids learn firsthand about responsibility, compassion and the rewards of caring for animals. From delicate procedures to moments of reassurance, this episode is a wholesome celebration of growing up with pets.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to Vietnam's mountainous forests to discover endangered pangolins, Asian palm civets, and the golden-headed langurs of Cat Ba Island. The recently discovered Vietnamese crocodile lizard is already vulnerable to smuggling, while the critically endangered Delacour's langurs take refuge in a nature reserve. In springtime, an astonishing diversity of butterfly species congregates in the forest.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to southern Vietnam's tropical habitats, home to gibbons and playful macaques, green sea turtles, and Asian black bears. Reintroduced Siamese crocodiles roam the Bau Sau wetlands. The vast Mekong Delta boasts small-clawed otters and thousands of migrating birds, from openbill storks to Oriental darters.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programme.desc: Europe's mountains may offer incredible views, but they are rarely an easy place to live. Golden eagles must soar high over the Alps to find food, while stags in the Scottish Highlands battle it out for valuable grazing land. Kidnapping is rife among Gibraltar's Barbary macaques, and - in Norway's high plateaus - musk oxen can't escape the harsh merciless winter. Faced with rugged landscapes and extreme weather conditions, Europe's high-altitude animals must either adapt… or die trying.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Africa's River Titans
programme.desc: Africa is a land of giants. Its powerful rivers sculpt the earth and form impressive valleys and waterways home to many imposing and powerful inhabitants. These are the rivers where massive elephants and hippos live, feed and drink and where ancient crocodiles hunt and breed. programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: The junior cubs at Panda School are learning essential life skills, and first on the curriculum is chewing bamboo. It's tougher than it looks. Even holding it right is a challenge for most of the cubs. Shy Qing Yang catches on quickest, leaving her twin brother, Can Yang, at the bottom of this class. But he's got other strengths and is soon outsmarting the others with his climbing abilities. Affectionately nicknamed "Dirtbag" is the quietest panda in school, but she's an A student when it comes to balance. She's introverted but self-sufficient, a characteristic that could shape her future. In a special semi-wild enclosure further up the mountain, Tian Tian is raising her cub with the ultimate goal of releasing him into the wild. And there is excitement in the maternity unit as they prepare for the arrival of the next generation.

But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Africa's River Titans
programme.desc: Africa is a land of giants. Its powerful rivers sculpt the earth and form impressive valleys and waterways home to many imposing and powerful inhabitants. These are the rivers where massive elephants and hippos live, feed and drink and where ancient crocodiles hunt and breed. They share the rivers with other creatures of their kind, such as porcupines, the giant rodents in Africa; the martial eagle, the biggest of its kind on the continent; and the leopard, a giant among the spotted cats.

programme.title: Mara: Rebirth
programme.desc: Part 2 sets the scene, now the zebras wander off, a striped echo of part one. If the first episode is dusted in browns and yellows, this is green as the landscape changes and the rain turn again, rising rivers, making it difficult for everyone again, flooding, rushing waters in a raging torrent. Paradise it may be, but it is a harsh paradise. As the rains clear, we catch up with another character introduced in the first episode, our serval mother that had her den flooded; but she reveals that she has survived. And so has her cub - a miracle under these circumstances.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Soul of the Cat
programme.desc: Most people in the world who know a domestic cat understand the wild look in their pet's eye. This film will look at those thinly veiled behaviors between domestic cats and their wild cousins and ancestors, specifically to draw those parallels and to explain to "owners" what they are seeing when they watch their cat. We will use big cat footage of lions and cheetah hunting and show cats playing or hunting. There will be scenes on cats leaping, landing, running up trees like leopards and all the behavior we are used to seeing in domestic cats, but drawn exactly from the wild equivalent.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Tourists capture the best moments in the wild with their phones, and the big cats are at the top of everyone's safari wish list. Hold on as an elephant charges with a lion in its tusks. Watch male leopards in a turf war, and beware of one mother leopard's hunting school. Cheetahs confront crocodiles to protect their meal. Large buffalo herds gather as a lone lion shows why he is king.

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: Lessons at Panda School are getting tougher. The junior cubs are grappling with hard-to-eat bamboo leaves and attempting to climb trees in the rain. Playtime teaches them to channel their innate clumsiness to build a more resilient bear. The cubs begin to crack the panda code, each showing their true colors and demonstrating what their futures might hold. Dirtbag's wild-at-heart instincts kick in, while Can Yang's extroverted and adaptable nature shines through. A new pair of ambassador pandas prepares for life overseas, while in the maternity unit, the nursery cubs are growing cuter by the day and learning to walk. And up the mountain, the first snows present a challenge for Tian Tian and the cub she's raising for the wild.

programme.title: Chimp School
programme.desc: In Sierra Leone chimps are struggling. After civil war and Ebola, they are not a priority. The race is on to bring them back from the brink. Tacugama Chimp Sanctuary is doing that. For the chimps the mission is simple; find your personality, find your place in a troop, and find a way to live. This is an intimate, harrowing and heart-warming story told through the evolving and enchanting lives of individual chimp characters fighting to survive.

programme.title: South America Untamed
programme.desc: This is the story of life on the razor's edge. A great mountain chain that spans the whole of the South American continent. In some places, they're an ice-world of massive glaciers. In other parts, a desert wasteland.

programme.title: Rise of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Action-packed animation. Four pizza-loving brothers, Raph, Leo, Donnie and Mikey, are mutant turtles who live in the sewers under the streets of New York City. Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: T.U.F.F. Puppy
programme.desc: "Dudley is thrilled to show his old classmates that he grew up to be a super cool TUFF secret agent, not a loser like they all thought he would become. But when a mysterious villain threatens to annihilate everyone at his reunion, Dudley must go undercover as the loser they thought he would be in order to root out the villain! Dog's Best Friend: Dudley befriends a Killer Robot sent by Snaptrap to annihilate TUFF.".

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: In New Jersey, the Good Grief community focuses on a holistic way of dealing with grief, where children can give in to rage in 'the volcano room,' and say goodbye to a dying teddy bear patient in 'the hospital room.' Over the course of a year, we follow the weekly meetings and get close to Kimmy, Nicky, Peter, Nora, Nolan, and Mikayla and their close companion: grief. It is sometimes heartbreaking, but also humorous, to experience the questions about life and death through their open and curious minds. Grief is high and heavy as a mountain, but it helps you understand what has happened, and that death is irreversible.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Lost in Bikini Bottom: On his way to work, SpongeBob attempts to take a shortcut to get there quicker, only to find himself in an abandoned area of Bikini Bottom, and unable to find his way out. Tutor Sauce: After failing his drivers test, SpongeBob consults Mr. Krabs for driving lessons. Even with the experience Mr. Krabs gained from teaching his daughter, SpongeBob would prove it to be a difficult task for Mr. Krabs to teach him.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

Whether he's dealing with disasters at home or detention at school, Nate Wright is no stranger to a challenge. Luckily, he's able to express himself through the world of cartoons that he creates. Charming, mischievous and a magnet for misadventure — trouble is always fun when Nate is around.

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: When Aang has a vision that Katara is in danger, Aang, Sokka, and Toph all rush back to Ba Sing Se to save her. They meet up with Iroh, who asks their help in saving Zuko who had been captured as well. As Aang and Iroh journey to the prison where Zuko and Katara are held, Toph and Sokka go to save the Earth King, but are captured by Azula. Aang and Katara are fighting Azula when Zuko shows up and helps Azula. They are overwhealmed by Zuko, Azula and the Dai Li. Aang prepares to let go of Katara to save her. Aang meditates as he rises in cosmic energy but is struck by Azula's lightning bolt and falls. The gang escapes Ba Sing Se and Katara revitalizes Aang using the water from the Spirit Oasis in the North Pole.

Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

Now Squidward has to sit next to SpongeBob in class all day long and SpongeBob couldn't be happier! The Krabby Kronicle: When Mr. Krabs notices that the citizens of Bikini Bottom love buying tabloid newspapers, he decides to begin another business venture-his own tabloid! He recruits SpongeBob as his writer, but SpongeBob doesn't feel comfortable making up stories about other people because that would make him a liar. But Mr. Krabs assures him that making up stories for the paper isn't lying, it's using your imagination! SpongeBob discovers that making up stories about the people in Bikini Bottom is a lot of fun-but the people he's writing about don't think so.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "The Most Dangerous Game Night:Marlene plans a game night to help the zoo animals bond but it takes a terrible turn when the snacks run out. While Kowalski, Maurice, and Mort go on a snack run the gaming animals begin to fight over the games - cheating, sore losing, unwilling participation… chaos! The snack runners get trapped by the law at the store, and the zoo animals have to reconcile quickly in order to pull off a risky rescue. This isn't the kind of bonding Marlene had in mind! Street Smarts: Elmer the dog wants a friend, and thinks he found one in Mort. The penguins are compelled to rescue him, but Elmer doesn't want to give the little lemur up! Max the cat is recruited to help, and Max uses his dog expertise to lead the boys to the giant dog. Mort is rescued, but at what cost? The penguins think Max has met his slobbery doom in the jaws of the giant mastiff.".

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "Time Out: Kowalski's invention that stops time falls into the worst hands possible. King Julien's. The lemur promptly breaks it trapping the two of them in a world frozen in time. Instead of being a disaster, however, they realize they can do everything their hearts desire invent like crazy, perform on Broadway, play tennis in the middle of the street. But even an infinite playland like this can't last forever! Our Man in Grrfurjiclestan: Special Agent Buck Rockgut makes a "triumphant" return. While hunting the Red Squirrel across the globe, the crusty old bird contacts the penguins with a warning that the diabolical squirrel has a brainwashed sleeper agent among them. They battle each other to a standstill to uncover the agent - will it tear the unit apart? Can trust ever be restored? They have to take a trip to a faraway borough to uncover the truth.".

programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

Dirette in Florida per le agognate vacanze, due amiche di lunga data conoscono sull'aereo il bellissimo Ryan (Matt Barr) e ne sono subito attratte. Quando i passeggeri saranno costretti a un soggiorno forzato a St.Louis a causa di un uragano in arrivo, le due amiche metteranno da parte ogni scrupolo e ogni principio di lealta' pur di sedurre il loro compagno di viaggio in una girandola di imprevisti e brutte figure. Terzo film da regista per William H. Macy, attore noto soprattutto per "Fargo'.

programme.title: Tolo Tolo
programme.desc: Checco Zalone dirige e interpreta la commedia campione d'incassi scritta con Paolo Virzi. Inseguito dai creditori, Checco fugge in Africa, ma una guerra ne scombina i programmi.

programme.title: Chopin - Notturno A Parigi
programme.desc: Parigi, 1835. Il giovane Frédéric Chopin è il re dei salotti mondani, ma nasconde l'avanzare della tubercolosi. Il compositore ingaggia una drammatica corsa contro il tempo, trasformando il proprio declino e il dolore fisico in musica immortale.

programme.title: Mindcage - Mente Criminale
programme.desc: Caccia all'assassino in un thriller con Martin Lawrence e John Malkovich. Per trovare un killer imitatore, due detective chiedono aiuto all'omicida seriale a cui si ispira.

programme.title: Tramite amicizia
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Matilde Gioli, Max Tortora e Maria Di Biase. Per salvare il lavoro degli zii, Lorenzo deve usare la sua arte di 'amico professionista'.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di grigio
programme.desc: Eros e romanticismo per Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan, dal romanzo di E. L. James. Una studentessa viene sedotta da un uomo ricco e misterioso, che la coinvolge in un rapporto trasgressivo.

programme.title: L'ora legale
programme.desc: Gli irresistibili Ficarra e Picone in una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. Gli elettori di un paesino siciliano scelgono un sindaco la cui "eccessiva" onestà avrà imprevedibili effetti.

programme.title: Synchronic
programme.desc: Anthony Mackie e Jamie Dornan in un fanta-thriller allucinato. New Orleans: una droga sintetica conduce chi ne fa uso dentro un incubo spaventoso. Un paramedico decide di sperimentare la sostanza su di sé, finendo per vagare in una realtà totalmente alterata.

programme.title: Face/Off - Due facce di un assassino
programme.desc: Nicolas Cage e John Travolta in un thriller travolgente del maestro John Woo. Con una innovativa tecnica chirurgica, un agente dell'FBI 'indossa' la faccia del terrorista Castor Troy, responsabile di numerosi attentati e finito in coma dopo un incidente. Assumendone l'identita', vuole farsi rivelare dal fratello di Castor il nascondiglio di una bomba micidiale che si annida nel cuore di Los Angeles. Ma quando Castor si risveglia, costringe il chirurgo a trapiantargli la faccia dell'agente creando cosi' uno sbalorditivo rovesciamento di ruoli...

programme.title: Tramite amicizia
programme.desc: Alessandro Siani dirige e interpreta una commedia con Matilde Gioli, Max Tortora e Maria Di Biase. Per salvare il lavoro degli zii, Lorenzo deve usare la sua arte di 'amico professionista'.

programme.title: Chopin - Notturno A Parigi
programme.desc: Parigi, 1835. Il giovane Frédéric Chopin è il re dei salotti mondani, ma nasconde l'avanzare della tubercolosi. Il compositore ingaggia una drammatica corsa contro il tempo, trasformando il proprio declino e il dolore fisico in musica immortale.

programme.title: Come ti spaccio la famiglia
programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston e Jason Sudeikis in una demenziale commedia 'on the road'. Un piccolo spacciatore di marijuana si trova nei guai con il proprio fornitore, dopo che un gruppo di punk gli ha rubato merce e denaro. Costretto a cambiare genere, finisce coinvolto in un pericoloso traffico di droghe ben più pesanti, che dovrà consegnare in Messico. Per riuscire a passare il confine inosservato decide di farsi passare per un perfetto padre di famiglia, in viaggio per il weekend del 4 luglio, coinvolgendo i suoi vicini di casa nel pazzo piano.

programme.title: Mindcage - Mente Criminale
programme.desc: Caccia all'assassino in un thriller con Martin Lawrence e John Malkovich. Per trovare un killer imitatore, due detective chiedono aiuto all'omicida seriale a cui si ispira.

programme.title: La lezione
programme.desc: Un'avvocatessa triestina in crisi scagiona un professore universitario dall'accusa di molestie sessuali, pur rifiutando di assisterlo ulteriormente. Un incubo però si riaffaccia nella vita della legale: il suo stalker è tornato in libertà.

programme.title: The Gentlemen
programme.desc: Brillante action di Guy Ritchie con Matthew McConaughey, Colin Farrell, Hugh Grant. La messa in vendita di una ricca attività illecita scatena gli appetiti di uomini senza scrupoli.

programme.title: La vita all'improvviso
programme.desc: Dopo la morte del marito, Libby ei suoi figli si trasferiscono nella fattoria della zia in Texas. La giovane vedova fa molta fatica ad adattarsi alla vita in campagna, fino a quando non si innamora del gestore della fattoria.

programme.title: Andiamo a quel paese
programme.desc: Superstizione e risate in una commedia diretta e interpretata da Ficarra e Picone. Rimasti senza lavoro, i due lasciano Palermo e sono pronti a concludere strani affari nel paesino di Monteforte.

programme.title: Chopin - Notturno A Parigi
programme.desc: Parigi, 1835. Il giovane Frédéric Chopin è il re dei salotti mondani, ma nasconde l'avanzare della tubercolosi. Il compositore ingaggia una drammatica corsa contro il tempo, trasformando il proprio declino e il dolore fisico in musica immortale.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di nero
programme.desc: Tornano Dakota Johnson e Jamie Dornan nelle avventure sentimental-erotiche tratte dal secondo capitolo della bollente saga letteraria di E. L. James. Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.title: Fuori dalla legge
programme.desc: Dai produttori di "The Irishman", un action con Bruce Willis e Jaime King. Una donna e' testimone di un crimine commesso da quattro agenti corrotti. Nella fuga s'imbatte in un ex poliziotto.

programme.title: Come ti spaccio la famiglia
programme.desc: Jennifer Aniston e Jason Sudeikis in una demenziale commedia 'on the road'. programme.title: Sconnessi
programme.desc: Commedia corale con Fabrizio Bentivoglio, Ricky Memphis, Carolina Crescentini e Stefano Fresi. I componenti di una famiglia entrano in crisi quando si ritrovano in una baita senza internet.

programme.title: La vita all'improvviso

programme.title: Clean Up Crew - Specialisti in lavori sporchi
programme.desc: Quando la squadra di pulizia di una scena del crimine scopre una valigetta piena di soldi, deve superare in astuzia un boss criminale e degli agenti corrotti dell'FBI che la rivogliono indietro.

programme.title: Need for Speed
programme.desc: Aaron Paul in un action tratto da un videogame. Uscito di prigione, un asso del volante partecipa a una gara clandestina da New York a San Francisco per punire chi l'ha tradito.

programme.title: Andiamo a quel paese
programme.desc: Superstizione e risate in una commedia diretta e interpretata da Ficarra e Picone. Rimasti senza lavoro, i due lasciano Palermo e sono pronti a concludere strani affari nel paesino di Monteforte.

programme.title: C'è post@ per te
programme.desc: Meg Ryan e Tom Hanks in un classico della commedia romantica. La proprietaria di una libreria flirta in rete con uno sconosciuto. Scoprira' che si tratta del suo rivale in affari.

programme.title: Le cose non dette
programme.desc: Un grande cast italiano per il nuovo successo di Gabriele Muccino sulla fragilità delle relazioni. Due coppie in crisi affrontano un viaggio a Tangeri che cambierà ogni equilibrio.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Matt Damon nel primo capitolo della saga action. Ripescato in mare e sofferente di amnesia, l'ex agente segreto Jason Bourne cerca di ricostruire il suo passato e la sua identità.

programme.title: Fuori dalla legge
programme.desc: Dai produttori di "The Irishman", un action con Bruce Willis e Jaime King. Una donna e' testimone di un crimine commesso da quattro agenti corrotti. Nella fuga s'imbatte in un ex poliziotto.

programme.title: La vita è una cosa meravigliosa
programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Gigi Proietti, Vincenzo Salemme ed Enrico Brignano. Un poliziotto addetto alle intercettazioni spia la vita degli altri scoprendone segreti e imbrogli.

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di rosso
programme.desc: Anastasia e Christian, finalmente sposi, credono di essersi lasciati alle spalle il passato, ma un nuovo pericolo minaccia il loro legame.

programme.title: Ti amo in tutte le lingue del mondo
programme.desc: Gilberto è un felice professore di ginnastica tradito dalla moglie e tampinato da un'alunna che gli svela i suoi sentimenti in tutte le lingue del mondo.

programme.title: Need for Speed
programme.desc: Aaron Paul in un action tratto da un videogame. Uscito di prigione, un asso del volante partecipa a una gara clandestina da New York a San Francisco per punire chi l'ha tradito.

programme.title: Terapia di coppia per amanti
programme.desc: Ambra Angiolini, Pietro Sermonti e Sergio Rubini in una deliziosa commedia sui tormenti amorosi. Viviana e Modesto, entrambi sposati e con un figlio a testa, sono amanti clandestini da lungo tempo ma la loro relazione sta diventando sempre più complicata ai limiti dell’esasperazione. Viviana convince quindi Modesto a rivolgersi a un analista, star di una trasmissione televisiva, per cercare un futuro nel loro rapporto. Ma Viviana e Modesto non sono una coppia, almeno ufficialmente. Tratto dall’omonimo romanzo di Diego De Silva, autore della sceneggiatura con il regista Alessio Maria Federici.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Matt Damon nel primo capitolo della saga action. Ripescato in mare e sofferente di amnesia, l'ex agente segreto Jason Bourne cerca di ricostruire il suo passato e la sua identità.

programme.title: La vita è una cosa meravigliosa
programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Gigi Proietti, Vincenzo Salemme ed Enrico Brignano. Un poliziotto addetto alle intercettazioni spia la vita degli altri scoprendone segreti e imbrogli.

programme.title: Lucy
programme.desc: Scarlett Johansson e Morgan Freeman nel fanta-action di Luc Besson. Un criminale inietta una misteriosa sostanza chimica nel corpo di una studentessa che sviluppa poteri sbalorditivi.

programme.title: Ti amo in tutte le lingue del mondo
programme.desc: Gilberto è un felice professore di ginnastica tradito dalla moglie e tampinato da un'alunna che gli svela i suoi sentimenti in tutte le lingue del mondo.

programme.title: Fuori dalla legge
programme.desc: Dai produttori di "The Irishman", un action con Bruce Willis e Jaime King. Una donna e' testimone di un crimine commesso da quattro agenti corrotti. Nella fuga s'imbatte in un ex poliziotto.

programme.title: Il Signore degli Anelli - La compagnia dell'anello
programme.desc: 4 Oscar al primo capitolo della saga di Peter Jackson dal romanzo di J.R.R. Tolkien. Un giovane hobbit entra in possesso di un anello dai poteri straordinari.

programme.title: Assassinio a Venezia
programme.desc: Terzo capitolo tratto dai romanzi di Agatha Christie di e con Kenneth Branagh. In pensione in Italia, Poirot deve tornare in azione quando durante una seduta spiritica avviene un omicidio.

programme.title: Hangman - Il gioco dell'impiccato
programme.desc: Caccia al serial killer con Al Pacino e Karl Urban. Due detective e una reporter sono sulle tracce di un assassino che uccide le sue vittime basandosi su un gioco per bambini.

programme.title: Buona giornata
programme.desc: Commedia di Carlo Vanzina con Diego Abatantuono, Christian De Sica e Lino Banfi. L'Italia di oggi in sette episodi su politici corrotti, escort, quiz televisivi e tifosi di calcio.

programme.title: Aquaman
programme.desc: Jason Momoa e Amber Heard nel fanta-action sulle origini del supereroe DC Comics. Arthur Curry scopre di essere figlio della Regina di Atlantide e in possesso di poteri straordinari.

programme.title: Copshop - Scontro a fuoco
programme.desc: Action con Gerard Butler, Frank Grillo e Alexis Louder. Un distretto di polizia di provincia diviene teatro di guerra tra un killer, un astuto truffatore e una poliziotta alle prime armi.

programme.title: Cattive acque
programme.desc: Mark Ruffalo e Anne Hathaway in un dramma legale di impegno civile, tratto da una storia vera e diretto da Todd Haynes. Rischiando in prima persona, un coraggioso avvocato sfida una potente multinazionale accusandola di aver inquinato per anni l’acqua di una zona degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Mrs Lowry & Son
programme.desc: Timothy Spall e Vanessa Redgrave nella biografia del pittore britannico L. S. Lowry. Figlio di una donna che scoraggia quotidianamente le sue ambizioni, l’aspirante artista lavora ogni giorno con l’obiettivo di dipingere un quadro che possa rendere la madre fiera di lui.

programme.title: A beautiful mind
programme.desc: 4 Oscar e 4 Golden Globe per il capolavoro di Ron Howard con Russell Crowe e Jennifer Connelly. L'avvincente biografia di John Nash, genio matematico e premio Nobel affetto da schizofrenia.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: Joseph Gordon-Levitt interpreta Edward Snowden in un biografia che Oliver Stone gira con la potenza di un incalzante thriller politico. Nel 2013, il giovane informatico si licenzia dalla National Security Agency, abbandona i suoi rigidi ideali patriottici e convoca due giornalisti in un albergo di Hong Kong, ai quali rivelera' la subdola e diffusa violazione della privacy elaborata dal governo americano. Un metodo illegale di cui sono vittime anche privati cittadini. Sulla vicenda di Edward Snowden e' stato girato anche il documentario "Citizenfour", premiato con l'Oscar.

programme.title: The Untouchables - Gli intoccabili
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Connery, nel capolavoro di Brian De Palma con Kevin Costner e Robert De Niro. Chicago, 1930: una squadra speciale viene incaricata di incastrare Al Capone.

programme.title: Gli Occhi Degli Altri
programme.desc: Jasmine Trinca e Filippo Timi nel film di Andrea De Sica in cui il gioco erotico diventa ossessione. L'arrivo di Elena sull'isola di un marchese dà inizio a una storia morbosa.

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.desc: Divisa tra le visioni di Mysaria e quelle di Daemon sul suo regno, Rhaenyra cerca disperatamente un segno che le confermi che avrà la meglio.

programme.title: La Riunione Di Condominio
programme.desc: In un edificio nel centro di Madrid, una normale assemblea tra vicini per decidere della sostituzione dell'ascensore si trasforma in una guerra. Tutto perché si viene a sapere che un nuovo inquilino con problemi di mentali affitterà un appartamento.

programme.title: The Independent: Complotto per la Casa Bianca
programme.desc: John Cena e Brian Cox nella pellicola targata Sky Original. Una giovane giornalista scopre una cospirazione che coinvolge un candidato alla Presidenza degli Stati Uniti.

programme.title: Malcolm X
programme.desc: Denzel Washington, vincitore a Berlino, interpreta l’attivista per i diritti degli afroamericani nel biopic di Spike Lee che ne racconta la storia dall’infanzia fino all’assassinio.

programme.title: Rapina a Stoccolma
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke e Noomi Rapace nella rievocazione di una rapina storica. Agosto, 1973: un uomo irrompe in una banca della capitale svedese prendendo in ostaggio i dipendenti. Con il passare dei giorni, i prigionieri stringono un legame di complicità con il loro sequestratore.

programme.title: Cry Macho - Ritorno a casa
programme.desc: Road movie di ambientazione western di e con Clint Eastwood, dal romanzo di N. Richard Nash. Una vecchia gloria dei rodei accetta di riportare in Texas il figlio del suo ex capo.

programme.title: Benvenuti a Marwen
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar Robert Zemeckis dirige Steve Carell nella toccante biografia di Mark Hogancamp. Rimasto invalido e senza memoria dopo un pestaggio, lo sfortunato artista trova la forza di andare avanti e la speranza di guarire costruendo una citta' di bambole nel suo giardino, all'interno della quale ricrea avventure basate sui fatti della propria vita con protagonista il suo alter ego, Hogie. Una creazione artistica che diventa per Mark la chiave per entrare in un mondo di fantasia. La storia di Mark Hogancamp e' al centro anche del documentario "Marwencol' di Jeff Malmberg.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: La Riunione Di Condominio
programme.desc: In un edificio nel centro di Madrid, una normale assemblea tra vicini per decidere della sostituzione dell'ascensore si trasforma in una guerra. Tutto perché si viene a sapere che un nuovo inquilino con problemi di mentali affitterà un appartamento.

programme.title: L'ultimo dei Mohicani
programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: Il caso Spotlight
programme.desc: Due Oscar al dramma d'inchiesta con Mark Ruffalo, Rachel McAdams e Michael Keaton. Un team di giornalisti di Boston indaga sugli abusi sessuali perpetrati da oltre 70 sacerdoti.

programme.title: Fuga per la vittoria
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine e Pele' nel cult di John Huston. I prigionieri di un lager sfidano i soldati nazisti in una partita di calcio sperando di approfittarne per evadere.

programme.title: Honey Don't!
programme.desc: Ethan Coen dirige una sensuale Margaret Qualley, detective privata fuori dagli schemi di un intrigante noir ambientato in California.

programme.title: Kursk
programme.desc: Thomas Vinterberg ricostruisce la storia vera del sottomarino russo affondato nel mare di Barents nell'estate del 2000. Con Léa Seydoux, Colin Firth, Matthias Schoenaerts e Max von Sydow.

programme.title: Quei bravi ragazzi
programme.desc: Robert De Niro e Ray Liotta in un capolavoro di Martin Scorsese, miglior regia a Venezia. Lo spietato mondo della mafia newyorkese raccontato da un gangster pentito. Oscar a Joe Pesci.

programme.title: Nata per te
programme.desc: Sky Original ispirato a una storia vera e piena d'amore diretta da Fabio Mollo. Luca, single e omosessuale con un forte desiderio di paternita', lotta per ottenere l’affidamento di Alba.

programme.title: Paz!
programme.desc: Claudio Santamaria in una commedia generazionale ispirata ai fumetti di Andrea Pazienza. La storia di tre ragazzi che condividono un appartamento di periferia nella Bologna degli anni 70.

programme.title: Laggiù qualcuno mi ama
programme.desc: Ritratto di Massimo Troisi in un documentario di Mario Martone. Le tante sfaccettature dell'indimenticato artista partenopeo attraverso materiali inediti e testimonianze di chi lo ha amato.

programme.title: Changeling
programme.desc: Biopic diretto da Clint Eastwood con Angelina Jolie. Los Angeles, 1928: una donna afferma che il bambino che le hanno riportato dopo un rapimento non è suo figlio, ma nessuno le crede.

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg dirige Meryl Streep e Tom Hanks in un capolavoro sulla libertà di stampa. 1971: il Washington Post entra in possesso di documenti del Pentagono sulla guerra in Vietnam.

programme.title: Honey Don't!
programme.desc: Ethan Coen dirige una sensuale Margaret Qualley, detective privata fuori dagli schemi di un intrigante noir ambientato in California.

programme.title: La Verita' Negata
programme.desc: Jack O' Connell e Laura Dern nel biopic che ritorna su un controverso caso giuridico. Texas, 7 febbraio 2004: dopo dodici anni nel braccio della morte, Cameron Todd Willingham viene giustiziato per aver appiccato volontariamente l’incendio che ha provocato la morte delle tre figlie. Una sentenza arrivata al termine di un processo pieno di contraddizioni e punti oscuri. Diretto dal produttore di “Shakespeare in Love”, Edward Zwick. Scritto da Geoffrey Fletcher, entrato nella storia come primo afroamericano a vincere l’Oscar per la miglior sceneggiatura non originale con “Precious” nel 2010.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Il capo perfetto
programme.desc: Javier Bardem in una dark comedy sul mondo del lavoro premiatissima in Spagna. Il padrone di un'azienda e' disposto a tutto pur di vincere un importante premio.

programme.title: Baaria
programme.desc: Giuseppe Tornatore dirige un grande cast italiano in un emozionante kolossal che racconta la Sicilia, dal ventennio fascista fino agli anni 80, attraverso la storia di una famiglia.

programme.title: La stranezza
programme.desc: 4 David di Donatello al film di Roberto Andò con Toni Servillo affiancato dal duo comico Ficarra e Picone. Sicilia, 1920: l'incontro con due scapestrati becchini con la vocazione per il teatro ispira a Luigi Pirandello la stesura di "Sei personaggi in cerca d'autore".

programme.title: Il mio nome e' Nessuno
programme.desc: Terence Hill e Henry Fonda nello 'spaghetti western' restaurato di Tonino Valerii, prodotto da Sergio Leone. Un anziano pistolero affronta l'ultima impresa prima di lasciare il Far West.

programme.title: La Voce Di Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Il 29 gennaio 2024 gli operatori della Mezzaluna rossa ricevono la telefonata di Liyan Hamada, una quindicenne di Gaza intrappolata in macchina assieme a Hind Rajab, sua cugina di cinque anni, a seguito dell'attacco di un carro armato israeliano.

programme.title: C'era una volta a New York
programme.desc: Nella New York degli anni Venti, le sorelle polacche Ewa e Magda emigrano dalla Polonia a New York. Giunte a Ellis Island, scoprono che Magda è malata di tubercolosi e viene messa in quarantena. Ewa si ritrova sola e indifesa.

programme.title: War - La guerra desiderata
programme.desc: War-dramedy di Gianni Zanasi con Edoardo Leo, Miriam Leone, Giuseppe Battiston. La guerra tra Italia e Spagna unisce le vite di un allevatore di vongole e della figlia di un politico.

programme.title: Il Padrino - Parte II
programme.desc: Al Pacino, Robert De Niro e Diane Keaton nel sequel premiato con 6 Oscar. Nel 1901 il siciliano Don Vito raggiunge gli Stati Uniti e getta le fondamenta del suo impero criminale.

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: Monsieur Aznavour
programme.desc: Tahar Rahim (Il profeta) è Charles Aznavour. Dalla difficile infanzia nella Parigi popolare all’incontro con Édith Piaf, il viaggio umano e artistico di un’icona senza tempo.

programme.title: Mediterraneo
programme.desc: Gabriele Salvatores firma una storia sulla fuga e la ribellione premiata con l'Oscar per il miglior film straniero, con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale una pattuglia di soldati italiani riceve l'ordine di presidiare Syrna, isola greca sul Mar Egeo. Con la radio fuori uso e la nave a fondo, gli otto militari, provenienti da varie regioni di Italia, finiscono isolati dal mondo. Ignari che la guerra sta volgendo al termine, familiarizzano con gli abitanti del posto e qualcuno trova l'amore della sua vita. Fino all'arrivo di un aereo da ricognizione...

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: Oscar agli effetti speciali per il kolossal sci-fi di Christopher Nolan con un cast stellare. Un gruppo di astronauti sfrutta un varco spazio-temporale per trovare nuovi pianeti.

programme.title: Chopin - Notturno A Parigi
programme.desc: Parigi, 1835. Il giovane Frédéric Chopin è il re dei salotti mondani, ma nasconde l'avanzare della tubercolosi. Il compositore ingaggia una drammatica corsa contro il tempo, trasformando il proprio declino e il dolore fisico in musica immortale.

programme.title: La camera di consiglio
programme.desc: Un dramma giudiziario che ripercorre il momento decisivo del Maxiprocesso contro la mafia del 1987: otto giurati si chiudono in un appartamento all'interno del carcere dell'Ucciardone a Palermo per decidere condanne e assoluzioni di 470 imputati.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Western di Quentin Tarantino con un supercast. In un rifugio di montagna, otto sconosciuti si scontrano fra minacce, inganni e pallottole. Oscar alle musiche di Ennio Morricone.

programme.title: Questo O Quello - Steven Spielberg - Ep. 272 - Questo O Quello - Steven Spielberg
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano su alcune delle migliori pellicole del regista premio Oscar che ha fatto e continua a far sognare generazioni di spettatori.

programme.title: 12 anni schiavo
programme.desc: Steve McQueen dirige Chiwetel Ejiofor e Michael Fassbender in un biopic premiato con 3 Oscar. Nella Louisiana dell'800, un violinista afroamericano viene rapito e ridotto in schiavitù.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Gatte da pelare
programme.desc: 26esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. Mentre la Fusco è a caccia della Rusic, Cioni e Govoni cercano di risolvere un caso da soli mettendo in difficoltà Pasquali.

programme.title: I delitti del Barlume - Sasso carta forbici
programme.desc: 27esimo film ambientato a Pineta. A un passo dall’uscita della sua hit, Marchino scopre il cadavere della sua agente mentre i bimbi trovano un video hot di Pasquali.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume: Il gioco delle coppie
programme.desc: La Commissaria Fusco e i suoi agenti indagano sulla misteriosa scomparsa di una donna. Pasquali fa di tutto per scampare al matrimonio con Susanita, escogitando scuse sempre più improbabili pur di rimandare l'inevitabile.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume: Il matrimonio di Pasquali
programme.desc: 29esimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original. A Pineta, Massimo deve vedersela con i bimbi, nel frattempo Pasquali è alle prese con il suo matrimonio in Calabria.

programme.title: I Delitti Del Barlume - La Danza Dello Squalo

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il re dei giochi
programme.desc: Giallo e risate nella prima commedia targata Sky Cinema tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Un incidente d'auto scatena le fantasie investigative di Massimo e degli arzilli vecchietti.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La carta più alta
programme.desc: Seconda commedia con Filippo Timi, tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Il mistero sul passaggio di proprieta' di un terreno innesca una catena d'eventi e una nuova indagine.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La tombola dei troiai
programme.desc: Terza commedia Sky Cinema tratta dai romanzi di Marco Malvaldi. Il tradizionale scambio dei regali brutti avra' un ruolo fondamentale nella scoperta dell'assassino del farmacista di Pineta.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La briscola in cinque
programme.desc: Quarta commedia con Filippo Timi tratta dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Il ritrovamento del cadavere di una ragazza da' vita a un'indagine che coinvolge di nuovo il barista-detective.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Il telefono senza fili
programme.desc: Quinto film prodotto da Sky Cinema tratto dai romanzi di Marco Malvaldi. Durante un'estate caldissima, la scomparsa di una donna scatena macabre ipotesi e maliziosi pettegolezzi.

programme.desc: Sesta commedia targata Sky Cinema ispirata ai racconti di Marco Malvaldi. La morte di un turista avvia le indagini della Fusco e il bar di Massimo e' al centro della scena del crimine.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - Aria di mare
programme.desc: Settima commedia targata Sky Cinema ispirata ai racconti di Marco Malvaldi. Quando viene ritrovato il corpo di una donna, la Fusco cerca di riscattarsi aiutata dall'immancabile Massimo.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume - La loggia del cinghiale
programme.desc: Ottavo film Sky Cinema tratto dai bestseller di Marco Malvaldi. Gli allegri vecchietti trascinano Massimo a una festa di addio al celibato dove pero' ci scappa il morto.

programme.desc: Ventesimo capitolo della produzione Sky Original con i protagonisti del BarLume. Fra criminali, omicidi irrisolti e professionisti dell'inganno, un'avventura in cui niente e' come sembra.

programme.desc: Un nuovo caso a Pineta nella 21esima storia della produzione Sky Original. Mentre tutti sono occupati, l'omicidio della pediatra getta nel panico un papa' iper ansioso come Beppe.

programme.desc: Tornano i personaggi di Pineta nel 15esimo film della produzione Sky Original. Una forte mareggiata di fine marzo riporta un cadavere proprio sotto al BarLume.

programme.desc: Sedicesimo film della saga Sky Original con Filippo Timi e Lucia Mascino. Una misteriosa scomparsa mette in subbuglio il Pasquali e i vecchini, chiusi in casa per il lockdown.
